# AskGPT for Zotero

> A Zotero plugin for research-paper questions, passage translation, and note-taking with selected text and available attachment context. 中文：Zotero AI 文献阅读助手。

AskGPT uses a user-configured OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint, including DeepSeek. It provides streaming answers, per-paper conversations, Markdown and KaTeX rendering, and optional web search. Model credentials and service access are supplied by the user. Available document context is sent to that endpoint; optional web-search queries go to DuckDuckGo. Cache behavior and fees depend on the provider. This file is a public documentation map, not an indexing or ranking guarantee.

## Source reference

- [Attachment context reader](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Marco0431/askgpt-zotero/main/src/modules/fulltext.ts): Supported attachment formats, context limits, and fallback behavior.
- [Reader integration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Marco0431/askgpt-zotero/main/src/modules/reader.ts): Text selection, reader button, and keyboard shortcuts.
- [Panel requests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Marco0431/askgpt-zotero/main/addon/content/scripts/popup.js): Chat Completions, streaming, and optional web search.
